question: Which element is the first element in group 13 of the periodic table?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Boron**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Boron (B) is th**e first element in group 13** of the periodic table.
 
• Group 13 is also known a**s the Boron family. **
 
• The** boron family is named after boron** because it is the first element in the group. 
 
• Boron is** generally unreactive with many elements**, but it can form compounds with hydrogen, called boranes. 
 
• Boron **can be used to make sodium perborate, a bleach alternativ**e.​
